answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. A beacon of per-task receipts records who did what, and the meadow of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, capped per identity per epoch, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the cipher of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
